item.title: More than 5 years later, woman who skipped hearing in deadly hit-and-run still not found
item.description: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) -- On Nov. 6, 2020, Trumonika Johnson, charged with hit-and-run in a crash that killed a motorcyclist, failed to show for a court hearing. A warrant was issued for her arrest. More than five years later, Johnson still hasn't been found, prosecutors confirmed Friday. She remains charged with hit-and-run causing death or permanent [...]

item.title: Super Bowl Monday is already a de facto holiday, so why not make it an official one?
item.description: After four or five hours of football, Bad Bunny and three-layer bean dip, how can anyone possibly be expected to show up for work Monday? And actually produce? Shouldn’t the Monday after the Super Bowl be a national holiday?
